meta.title: OSIDAC — Virtual stores, daily missions, and community
meta.description: Manage a virtual store, complete daily missions, and collect OSID Coins for in-app use. Cash top-ups and withdrawals are not available.

hero.badge: Virtual store · daily missions · steady progress
hero.title: Open your digital storefront. Move forward every day.
hero.subtitle: Manage a virtual store, complete daily missions, and collect OSID Coins for in-app use. OSID Coins are not cash and cannot be withdrawn.
hero.imageAlt: Small business owner checking her phone in a warm cafe

how.title: A simple way to get started
how.subtitle: Create a free account, open a virtual store, and explore the activities currently available.
how.buyHook: Sign up and open your store
how.buyText: Registration is free. You do not need to buy a membership to use the available virtual store and daily missions.
how.buyAlt: A virtual storefront on a phone with an in-app rewards balance
how.getText: Collect OSID Coins through in-app activities. Coins are app points only; they have no cash value and cannot be redeemed.
how.getAlt: A person checking a daily task list on a phone
how.wdHook: Track your activity in one wallet
how.wdText: View your OSID Coins and activity history. Cash top-ups and withdrawals are not available.
how.wdAlt: Small business owner checking a phone in her shop

earn.title: Explore what is available today
earn.subtitle: Start with a virtual store, daily missions, and referral tracking. Paid partner offers, game rewards, network commissions, and cash withdrawals are not available.
earn.storeText: Claim your virtual store every eight hours to collect OSID Coins. Coins are for in-app use only.
earn.missionText: Complete check-ins and verified referral activities. Paid partner missions are not available.
earn.playText: Game-based rewards are not available. Partner activities will appear after an integration is enabled.
earn.teamText: Share an invite link and track your network. Network commissions are not available.

packages.title: Membership tiers
packages.subtitle: Tier purchases are not available yet. Prices are shown for reference; mission access and tier benefits will be explained before checkout opens.

starter.name: Starter Booth
starter.desc: An entry tier for starting a virtual storefront.

kios.name: Kios Pro
kios.desc: A tier for a virtual storefront that is growing.

gold.name: Warung Gold
gold.desc: An advanced tier in the OSIDAC membership catalog.

elite.name: Franchise Elite
elite.desc: An advanced membership tier in the OSIDAC catalog.

master.name: Empire Master
master.desc: The highest tier in the OSIDAC membership catalog.

network.title: Grow with the OSIDAC community
network.subtitle: Invite people to join and follow your direct and extended network. Network commissions are not available.
network.note: Referral tracking helps you build community; no network commissions are currently paid. Available features do not require a tier purchase.
network.imageAlt: Two small business owners talking while reviewing a tablet

transparency.title: Know what your balance represents
transparency.subtitle: OSID Coins are in-app points, not money. Cash top-ups and withdrawals are not available. Full terms will be shown before any financial feature is enabled.
transparency.formula: OSID Coins have no cash value and cannot be withdrawn.
transparency.disclaimer: OSIDAC is not an investment product and does not promise income. No crypto assets are used.

cta.title: Start with your own virtual store.
cta.subtitle: Create a free account to explore available store and mission features. OSID Coins are not redeemable for cash.

footer.legal: OSIDAC is not an investment product and does not promise income. OSID Coins are in-app points with no cash value. Paid memberships, partner missions, network commissions, cash top-ups, and withdrawals are not available yet.

auth.registerSubtitle: Create a free account. No membership purchase is required.
